name: 1995 Honda Civic SiR-II Hatch (EG6)
notes: 1995 E-EG6 SiR-II 5MT, operated in the game's 1996 setting. Factory figures describe the power-steering, no-A/C, no-sunroof, no-ABS 1050 kg variant. Simulation assumptions below are provisional and are not Honda specifications. Values used by the physics loader are SI.

redline.source: Provisional driver shift point; Honda peak-power RPM is 7800, but redline is not given in the cited specifications

fuel_cut.source: Provisional ECU cutoff; not specified by the cited Honda source

torque_curve.source: Honda Civic SiR-II (E-EG6) specifications (1995-08), https://www.honda.co.jp/auto-archive/civic/2-3door/3door-1995/sir2_sy.html; factory peak torque at 7300 rpm and peak power at 7800 rpm; all other points are a provisional interpolation/shape assumption, not a measured dyno curve
torque_curve.notes: 7800-rpm torque is calculated from 170 PS using P=T*omega. The other points, including low-RPM/VTEC behavior, require measured data before engineering claims. Do not tune this shape to a desired lap or acceleration time.

efficiency.source: Provisional FWD drivetrain-loss assumption retained from the EJ6 reference model; not an EG6 measurement

shift_time.source: Provisional driver behavior retained from the EJ6 reference model; not a factory vehicle property

launch_rpm.source: Provisional driver launch behavior retained from the EJ6 reference model; not a factory vehicle property

engine_inertia.source: Provisional rotational-inertia assumption retained from the EJ6 reference model; B16A-specific measurement unavailable

drivetrain_source: Honda Civic SiR-II (E-EG6) specifications (1995-08), https://www.honda.co.jp/auto-archive/civic/2-3door/3door-1995/sir2_sy.html: transverse engine, front-wheel drivetrain

curb.source: Honda Civic SiR-II (E-EG6) specifications (1995-08), https://www.honda.co.jp/auto-archive/civic/2-3door/3door-1995/sir2_sy.html, 5MT power-steering configuration without listed A/C/sunroof/ABS options

driver.source: Reference-simulation driver-mass convention; not Honda curb weight

fuel.source: Derived from Honda 45 L tank capacity (https://www.honda.co.jp/auto-archive/civic/2-3door/3door-1995/sir2_sy.html) with assumed half tank and 0.74 kg/L fuel density

weight_front_fraction.source: Provisional static front-weight assumption retained from the EJ6 reference model; EG6 corner weights unavailable

cg_height.source: Provisional compact-car CG-height assumption retained from the EJ6 reference model; EG6 measurement unavailable

roll_stiffness_front.source: Provisional front roll-stiffness share retained from the EJ6 reference model; not inferred from Honda double-wishbone layout

radius.source: Calculated unloaded radius from Honda 195/55R15 tire marking (https://www.honda.co.jp/auto-archive/civic/2-3door/3door-1995/sir2_sy.html): (15*25.4/2 + 195*0.55)/1000

mu_0.source: Provisional tire-grip coefficient retained from EJ6 reference model; no EG6 tire test or compound specified

load_sensitivity_k.source: Provisional tire load-sensitivity assumption retained from EJ6 reference model

rolling_resistance.source: Provisional passenger-tire rolling-resistance assumption retained from EJ6 reference model

wheel_inertia.source: Provisional wheel/tire inertia retained from EJ6 reference model; 15-inch EG6 wheel and tire mass not measured

cd.source: Provisional drag coefficient retained from EJ6 reference model; EG6 hatch Cd unavailable

frontal_area.source: Derived from Honda width 1.695 m and height 1.350 m (https://www.honda.co.jp/auto-archive/civic/2-3door/3door-1995/sir2_sy.html) using assumed 0.85 frontal fill factor

cla.source: Neutral aero placeholder retained from EJ6 reference model; not a measured EG6 lift/downforce value

abs.source: Honda Civic SiR-II (E-EG6) specifications (1995-08), https://www.honda.co.jp/auto-archive/civic/2-3door/3door-1995/sir2_sy.html lists ABS as an option; baseline selects the non-ABS configuration

bias.source: Existing simulation's ideal-bias simplification; not Honda brake-proportioning data

front_rotor_mass.source: Provisional rotor-mass assumption retained from EJ6 reference model; EG6 front rotor mass unavailable

rotor_specific_heat.source: Cast-iron material-property estimate retained from EJ6 reference model

pad_mu.source: Provisional OEM street-pad coefficient retained from EJ6 reference model

pad_fade_temp.source: Provisional brake-pad fade onset retained from EJ6 reference model

pad_fade_rate.source: Provisional brake-pad fade slope retained from EJ6 reference model

pad_mu_min.source: Existing simulation's cooked-pad friction floor; not Honda data

capacity_ratio.source: Provisional front-brake capacity relative to tire grip retained from EJ6 reference model

cooling_h0.source: Provisional still-air rotor cooling retained from EJ6 reference model

cooling_h1.source: Provisional speed-dependent rotor cooling retained from EJ6 reference model
